chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Wahb ibn ʿAbd Rabbih, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who married his Umm al-Walad to a slave of his, then the master died.
He عليه السلام said: “She has no choice regarding the slave; she is owned by the heirs.”

key_terms.أُمَّ وَلَدٍ: a female slave who has borne her master a child
key_terms.عَبْدًا: a male slave owned by the master
key_terms.لِلْوَرَثَةِ: belonging to the heirs after the master's death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a master marries his Umm al-Walad to his slave and then dies?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about an Umm al-Walad who had been married by her master to his slave, and then the master died. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that she has no option of choice against the slave, and that her status is tied to the heirs as inherited property.
